commands.description:
The commands between ticks, packed as described in the module documentation, then
base64.

content_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the game content the run used, lowercase hex: the setup's mode, every
preset, the run stats and the rewards (`content_sha256_with`). Other content invalidates
the replay.

final_hash.description:
The FNV-1a 64 state hash after the last tick and the commands after it (ADR-019), 16
lowercase hex digits.

inputs.description: The per-tick inputs, packed as a stage replay's are, then base64.

ticks.description: Ticks recorded, at most the mode's length. A run that ended ends on the tick it ended.

ContentId.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-026): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

RunSetup.description:
What a run starts from: built by the app from local storage when a run starts, and stored
in the run's replay (ADR-051).

extra_rerolls.description: Rerolls the player's progress adds to the stage's, at most `MAX_EXTRA_REROLLS`.

main.description: A weapon preset, used in its Main role.

main_expertise.description: The Main weapon's expertise level, at most `MAX_EXPERTISE` (10); grants nothing yet.

mode.description: A mode ID: the content the run plays.

seed.description: Seeds the run's SplitMix64 (ADR-033), all 64 bits.

star_pool.description:
The rewards an offer may hold, by the IDs of the run's rewards file: the player's choice
in the Star Chart (ADR-066 §1), each at most once. Absent: every reward in the file.

sub.description: A weapon preset, used in its Sub role.

sub_expertise.description: The Sub weapon's expertise level, at most `MAX_EXPERTISE` (10); grants nothing yet.
